item.title: Kitakata Ramen: One of Japan's Three Great Ramen Styles — Guide
item.description: Kitakata ramen is ranked among Japan’s three great regional ramen styles, distinguished by thick, wavy, hand-cut noodles in a light, clear soy-and-pork (shoyu) broth. The small city of Kitakata, with a population of roughly 30,000, is home to more than 100 ramen shops — reportedly the highest ramen-shop density per capita in Japan — many of them family-run for generations, and locals famously eat it for breakfast (asa-ramen) as often as lunch or dinner.
